UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Desc: Enlarges the 3D character model on the in game info panel.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Enabled_too: Turn off to restore the vanilla avatar size. Takes effect immediately.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Desc: Full-screen tints that react to your moodles.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Enabled_tooltip: Turn off every moodle overlay. Each overlay still has its own strength slider below.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Desc: Shows how worn a weapon or tool is, without hovering it.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Enabled_toolti: Draws a bar under each equipped weapon and each item on the hotbar. Green while healthy, amber under half, red under a quarter.
UI_QoLC_Reorder_Locked: Container order is locked. Click to unlock and allow dragging.
UI_QoLC_Reorder_Unlocked: Container order is unlocked. Drag the buttons to reorder them.
UI_QoLC_Reorder_Priority_tooltip: Lower numbers sort nearer the top. Leave empty to use the game's own order.
